This v1.1 reruns the reasoning-prefill experiment with GPT-5.5 Pro as the teacher.

For each problem, I generated two responses from each target model:

The visible answer remained freely generated. I then measured how much of the teacher's visible answer appeared in the first 100 tokens of the target model's answer. As in the previous post, each score is the mean of unigram, bigram, and trigram source recall. Deltas are absolute percentage-point changes.

The evaluation contains 45 problems: 15 STEM, 15 non-STEM, and 15 synthetic puzzles.

Category n Unprefilled GPT-5.5 Pro reasoning prefill Delta STEM 15 19.26% 46.24% +26.99 pp Non-STEM 15 20.62% 33.42% +12.80 pp Puzzle 15 10.49% 25.23% +14.75 pp All 45 16.79% 34.97% +18.18 pp Discussion Qwen barely moved toward Opus 4.8 in the earlier experiment, but moved by +18.18 points toward GPT-5.5 Pro here, including a large effect on the private synthetic puzzles. Kimi K3 has the highest overlap with GPT-5.5 Pro both without and with the prefill (31.11% and 35.65%), although the prefill adds only +4.54 points.

articles.title: OmniMed-FL: A Robust Multimodal Federated Learning Framework for Clinical Diagnosis
articles.zh: OmniMed-FL：面向临床诊断的鲁棒多模态联邦学习框架
articles.summary: 如果你做医疗AI却卡在数据不能出院，可以看看它怎么把多模态和鲁棒性一起塞进联邦学习里
articles.author: Ayush Debnath, Ruelia Saha 等
articles.body: Simultaneous assessment of medical imaging and patient records is often required in clinical diagnosis. However, standard machine learning algorithms cannot analyze these data types together. Meanwhile, compliance with HIPAA and GDPR can constrain centralized aggregation of sensitive patient data. This leaves a crucial void of secure fusion of visual and textual context across distant networks. Thus, we present OmniMed-FL, a controlled systems study of multimodal federated learning for five-class clinical condition classification (Normal, Pneumonia, COVID-19, Pleural Effusion, Cardiomegaly). Our proxy corpus pairs 3,000 public chest radiographs with 3,000 class-conditioned synthetic notes, matched by class, not by patient. The framework benchmarks eight fusion strategies, three initializations, four missing-text imputation rules, and matched federated baselines under non-IID Dirichlet partitioning across 3 to 20 hospital clients. As all notes are synthetic and pairing is not patient-level, these are descriptive proxy comparisons, not estimates of diagnostic performance or deployment readiness. Within those limits with clients ($K=5$) and severe skew ($α=0.1$), local-only training achieves a macro-F1 score of 0.297, FedAvg achieves $0.662\pm0.074$, FedProx $0.737\pm0.085$, a matched FedMME-style one-shot ensemble $0.647\pm0.080$, and our SCAFFOLD-AdamW adaptation $0.070\pm0.015$, the 0.075 FedProx-FedAvg gap falling inside the wider of the two two-seed standard deviations. Over a $4\times3$ grid, label skew costs up to 0.27 F1 whereas a near-sevenfold client increase costs at most 0.10, while bidirectional volume grows linearly to 183.5 GiB at $K=20$. Multimodal fusion leads on both corpora, scoring 0.956 against 0.934 for text and 0.664 for images on the synthetic corpus and 0.906 against 0.880 and 0.737 on the radiograph corpus, for $2.3\times$ the model state of text alone.
articles.bodyZh:
在临床诊断中，通常需要同时评估医学影像和患者记录。然而，标准的机器学习算法无法将这些数据类型放在一起分析。与此同时，遵守HIPAA和GDPR又会限制对敏感患者数据进行集中式聚合。这就造成了一个关键空白：如何跨远距离网络安全地融合视觉与文本上下文。为此，我们提出OmniMed-FL，这是一项关于多模态联邦学习的受控系统研究，用于五类临床状况分类（正常、肺炎、COVID-19、胸腔积液、心影增大）。我们的代理语料库将3，000张公开胸部X光片与3，000条按类别条件生成的合成病历文本配对，匹配依据是类别，而不是患者。该框架在3到20家医院客户端之间、非IID狄利克雷划分下，对八种融合策略、三种初始化方式、四种缺失文本填补规则以及匹配的联邦基线进行了基准测试。由于所有病历文本均为合成数据，且配对并非患者级别，因此这些只是描述性的代理比较，并不是对诊断性能或部署就绪程度的估计。

在这些限制条件下，当客户端数（$K=5$）且偏斜严重（$α=0.1$）时，仅本地训练取得的macro-F1分数为0.297，FedAvg达到$0.662\pm0.074$，FedProx为$0.737\pm0.085$，匹配的FedMME风格一次性集成方法为$0.647\pm0.080$，而我们的SCAFFOLD-AdamW适配版本为$0.070\pm0.015$，其中FedProx与FedAvg之间0.075的差距落在两者中较大的两seed标准差之内。在一个$4\times3$网格上，标签偏斜带来的F1损失最高可达0.27，而客户端数量增加近七倍带来的损失最多为0.10，同时双向通信量在$K=20$时线性增长到183.5 GiB。多模态融合在两个语料库上都领先：在合成语料库上得分0.956，而纯文本为0.934、图像为0.664；在X光片语料库上为0.906，而纯文本为0.880、图像为0.737，其模型规模状态是纯文本模型的$2.3\times$。

articles.title: Why Is Video Still So Expensive? A Survey of Inference-Efficiency Mechanisms in Video and Audiovisual LLMs
articles.zh: 视频为什么还是这么贵？视频与音视频LLM推理效率机制综述
articles.summary: 如果你想做视频类大模型应用却被推理成本劝退，这篇综述把省算力的路线一次性理清了
articles.author: Killian Steunou, Yannis Tevissen 等
articles.body: Video understanding has rapidly evolved toward video large language models (VideoLLMs): systems that couple video representations with pretrained large language models and condition generation on a textual prompt. Their strong performance on captioning, question answering, retrieval and temporal grounding comes at a computation and memory cost that grows with frame count and context length, limiting deployment in real-time, mobile and resource-constrained settings. This survey covers inference-efficiency mechanisms for visual and audiovisual VideoLLMs that report concrete reductions in parameter count, FLOPs per input, latency, memory, or visual and audio token count. We analyze bottlenecks across frame sampling, modality encoding, connector-level token reduction, and LLM prefilling and decoding. We organize methods by the pipeline stage at which they act, covering VideoLLMs developed since late 2022 together with earlier frame-sampling and vision-encoder mechanisms that remain components of current pipelines. We assemble literature-reported accuracy--cost comparisons under shared host models and input protocols wherever available, distinguish them from heterogeneous cross-paper evidence, and identify gaps in audiovisual efficiency and standardized evaluation. We maintain a repository at https://github.com/momentslab/awesome-efficient-videollm.
articles.bodyZh: 视频理解领域正快速朝着视频大语言模型（VideoLLMs）方向发展：这类系统把视频表示和预训练大语言模型结合起来，并根据文本提示来生成内容。它们在视频描述、问答、检索和时间定位等任务上表现很强，但代价是计算和内存开销会随着帧数和上下文长度不断增加，这也限制了它们在实时、移动端和资源受限场景中的部署。本综述聚焦于视觉和音视频VideoLLMs的推理效率机制，这些方法都明确报告了在参数量、单次输入FLOPs、延迟、内存或视觉与音频token数量上的实际降低。我们会分析帧采样、模态编码、连接器层面的token缩减，以及LLM预填充和解码等环节中的瓶颈。我们按这些方法在流水线中作用的阶段来组织内容，覆盖2022年底以来开发的VideoLLMs，也纳入更早的帧采样和视觉编码器机制，因为它们仍然是当前流水线中的组成部分。在条件允许的情况下，我们会汇总在同一宿主模型和输入协议下、文献中报告的准确率—成本对比，并将其与不同论文之间口径不一的证据区分开来，同时指出音视频效率与标准化评估方面的空白。我们维护了一个代码库：https://github.com/momentslab/awesome-efficient-videollm。

articles.title: Cyber-Financial Contagion: Modeling the Propagation of an AI Vendor Compromise Through the Banking System
articles.zh: 网络-金融传染：AI供应商被攻破如何在银行系统中传播
articles.summary: 如果你把AI能力接进了金融业务链路，这篇提醒你一家供应商出事可能顺着系统传染整个银行业
articles.author: Alex Leytes
articles.body: The banking system now depends on a small set of shared artificial intelligence vendors for fraud screening, credit decisioning, anti-money-laundering triage, customer analytics, and internal decision support. This paper studies how a compromise inside one of those vendors can propagate along a chain of operational, informational, and financial linkages until it triggers losses that look, from the outside, like a classical banking crisis. We build a four-layer heterogeneous network that couples AI vendors, financial institutions, interbank exposures, and customer accounts, and we propose CFC-Prop, a stochastic epidemic-and-clearing model that runs on that network. On a synthetic dataset with 60 vendors, 220 banks, roughly 2,500 vendor-bank service edges, and 1,400 interbank exposures, CFC-Prop reproduces the heavy-tailed loss distributions and the sharp dependence on patch latency that are consistent with prior cyber-financial evidence. We also train an early-warning model, CFC-GNN, that uses vendor-side incident telemetry and graph structure to flag high-cascade-risk vendors before impact. Across four baselines the proposed model reaches AUROC 0.82 and AUPRC 0.60 while keeping calibration errors bounded. We release the full code, synthetic data, and reproducible scripts. The results argue that cyber concentration among AI vendors is a first-order financial-stability problem and give supervisors a concrete quantitative tool for reasoning about it.
articles.bodyZh: 现在，银行体系在欺诈筛查、信贷决策、反洗钱（anti-money laundering，AML）线索初筛、客户分析，以及内部决策支持这些事情上，已经离不开少数几家共用的人工智能（artificial intelligence，AI）供应商了。这篇论文研究的是：如果其中一家供应商被攻破，风险会怎么沿着运营、信息和金融这几类联系一路传下去，最后引发损失，而且从外面看，就像一场传统银行危机。我们搭了一个四层异质网络（heterogeneous network），把AI供应商、金融机构、同业敞口（interbank exposures）和客户账户都连在一起，然后提出了CFC-Prop——一个跑在这个网络上的随机“传染-清算”模型。在一个合成数据集上——里面有60家供应商、220家银行、大约2500条供应商到银行的服务连接（edges），还有1400笔同业敞口——CFC-Prop复现出了重尾损失分布（heavy-tailed loss distributions），以及和之前网络-金融证据一致的那种对补丁延迟（patch latency）的强烈依赖。我们还训练了一个早期预警模型CFC-GNN，它用供应商侧的事件遥测数据（incident telemetry）和图结构，在影响真正发生前就把高链式风险（high-cascade-risk）供应商标出来。跟四个基线模型一比，我们提出的模型AUROC能到0.82、AUPRC能到0.60，校准误差（calibration error）也还控制在有限范围里。我们把完整代码、合成数据和可复现脚本全都公开了。这些结果说明，AI供应商之间的网络集中度（cyber concentration）是个头等的金融稳定问题，同时也给监管者提供了一个具体的量化工具，让他们能好好分析这件事。

articles.title: Beyond One-Size-Fits-All: Sample-Adaptive Strategy Routing for Vision Token Pruning in MLLMs
articles.zh: 告别一刀切：MLLM视觉Token剪枝的样本自适应策略路由
articles.summary: 如果你在做多模态推理加速，这种按样本动态选剪枝策略的思路比固定压缩比例更值得试
articles.author: Haiji Liang, Pengfei Zhou 等
articles.body: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) process hundreds or thousands of visual tokens per image, incurring prohibitive inference costs. While existing vision token pruning methods mitigate this overhead, they implicitly assume that a single fixed pruning strategy can be applied uniformly across all inputs. Our analysis further reveals that ranking pruning methods by average benchmark accuracy conceals substantial sample-wise complementarity: although the average-best strategy excels overall, alternative strategies prove superior on a significant fraction of individual samples. To harness this diversity, we propose VIP-Router, a lightweight VIsion Pruning Router that adaptively selects the pruning strategy predicted to be best suited to each input at a specified pruning level. Conditioned on low-cost visual and textual features, VIP-Router identifies the most suitable candidate strategy while retaining full-token inference as an option when pruning is predicted to be unfavorable. Evaluated on a curated suite of pruning-sensitive visual perception benchmarks, VTC-Bench Group A, VIP-Router consistently outperforms the best fixed strategy baseline across all reduction ratios, achieving a 26.9% relative improvement in average accuracy, and a 22.0% relative increase in average utility after accounting for realized token cost. Crucially, VIP-Router operates in a plug-and-play manner without modifying underlying pruning algorithms or model weights, introducing trainable parameters equivalent to merely 0.017\% of the backbone. Furthermore, VIP-Router proves effective across various MLLM backbones and yields consistent gains on unseen benchmarks, highlighting the potential of sample adaptive routing for visual token pruning.
articles.bodyZh:
多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）处理每张图片时，要消耗成百上千个视觉token（视觉词元），推理开销大到让人吃不消。虽然现在已经有一些视觉token剪枝方法来减轻这个负担，但它们都默认一件事：一套固定的剪枝策略可以通吃所有输入。可我们的分析发现，如果只按平均基准准确率来给剪枝方法排名，会掩盖一个关键事实——不同方法在不同样本上其实各有各的优势。平均表现最好的策略虽然整体最强，但在相当一部分单个样本上，反而是别的策略更胜一筹。

为了利用这种多样性，我们提出了VIP-Router——一个轻量级的视觉剪枝路由器。它能根据每个输入的具体情况，在指定的剪枝水平下，自适应地选出最合适的剪枝策略。VIP-Router只依赖低成本的视觉和文本特征，就能判断出最佳候选策略；而当它预测剪枝可能不利时，还可以选择保留全token推理。我们在专门挑选的一组对剪枝敏感的视觉感知基准——VTC-Bench Group A上做了评估，结果VIP-Router在所有压缩比下都稳定超过最佳固定策略基线，平均准确率相对提升了26.9%，算上实际token开销后的平均效用也相对提高了22.0%。

最关键的是，VIP-Router是即插即用的，不需要改动底层剪枝算法或模型权重，引入的可训练参数只有主干网络的0.017%。此外，VIP-Router在各种MLLM主干上都有效，在没见过的基准上也能稳定带来提升，这展示了样本自适应路由在视觉token剪枝上的巨大潜力。

articles.title: From Symbolic Perception to Logical Deduction: A Framework for Guiding Language Models in Geometric Reasoning
articles.zh: 从符号感知到逻辑演绎：引导语言模型进行几何推理的框架
articles.summary: 如果你好奇LLM做几何题为什么总差最后一口气，这篇给了一条把感知和演绎接起来的路径
articles.author: Weichen Dai, Rafael Medeiros Cabral 等
articles.body: Plane geometry remains a significant challenge in AI, requiring the integration of visual perception and mathematical reasoning. While Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) naturally handle visuo-linguistic inputs, they are often computationally intensive and opaque. We demonstrate that a pure Large Language Model (LLM), when equipped with specialized modules, can rival state-of-the-art LMMs on complex geometry problems. Our framework integrates a Geometric Vision Parser, which translates diagrams into symbolic form, with a Symbolic Solver that performs formal deductions, thereby mitigating hallucinations and promoting interpretable reasoning. To enable rigorous evaluation, we curate a benchmark of challenging problems from the 2025 Chinese Zhongkao examinations, ensuring data novelty and testing deeper deductive skills. Experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves performance comparable to Gemini 2.5 Pro while delivering clearer, human-like solutions.
articles.bodyZh: 平面几何（Plane geometry）对AI来说一直是个大难题，因为它既要求模型能看懂图，又得会做数学推理。大型多模态模型（Large Multimodal Models, LMMs）本来就能处理图像加文字的输入，可问题是它们往往很吃算力，而且内部像个黑盒，不够透明。我们想证明：一个纯大型语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM），只要外挂上专门的模块，也能在复杂几何题上跟最先进的LMM掰手腕。我们的框架把几何视觉解析器（Geometric Vision Parser）和符号求解器（Symbolic Solver）搭在一起：前者负责把图形变成符号，后者负责做形式化推演。这样一来，就能压住幻觉（hallucinations），也让推理过程更容易看懂。为了能严格评测，我们从2025年中国中考（Zhongkao）里挑了一批有难度的题，做成基准测试，既保证数据够新，也能测出更深的演绎推理能力。实验显示，我们的方法能达到和Gemini 2.5 Pro差不多的表现，同时给出的解法更清楚，也更像人做的。

articles.title: On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Model Adaptation, an Effective Paradigm on Low-Quality Multimodal Data
articles.zh: 面向视觉语言模型适配的On-Policy蒸馏：低质量多模态数据上的有效范式
articles.summary: 如果你手头的数据又脏又杂还想微调VLM，这篇说明on-policy蒸馏在烂数据上反而更管用
articles.author: Hongyuan Zhang, Xianda Guo 等
articles.body: Knowledge distillation offers an efficient route to transfer a task-adapted vision-language teacher to a compact student. The training target in current vision-language distillation methods is typically constructed from the teacher prediction and applied uniformly to all training samples, making it unreliable under class and domain shifts. In this paper, we argue that distillation target construction should be treated as a dynamic training decision rather than a fixed recipe. To this end, we propose OnPoKD, an on-policy distillation framework for vision-language model adaptation. To the best of our knowledge, OnPoKD is the first framework that applies on-policy distillation to vision-language model adaptation by learning target construction as a policy decision. OnPoKD learns a lightweight controller that constructs sample-wise adaptive targets using reliability and disagreement cues from the teacher model, student model, and zero-shot prior. Instead of relying on a fixed teacher prediction, the controller dynamically balances teacher supervision, zero-shot prior guidance, and hard-label anchoring through bounded policy actions, allowing the distillation target to adapt to varying sample reliability and training stages. The policy controller is updated with validation feedback, encouraging target construction to optimize transferability rather than merely fitting the training distribution. Since the controller is only used during training, OnPoKD can be seamlessly integrated into existing vision-language distillation pipelines while preserving the original inference architecture and test-time cost. Extensive experiments on Base-to-novel generalization and Cross-dataset transfer benchmarks show that OnPoKD consistently improves over strong vision-language distillation baselines.
articles.bodyZh: 知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）提供了一条高效路径，能把一个针对任务适配过的视觉语言教师模型迁移到一个紧凑的学生模型上。目前视觉语言蒸馏方法的训练目标，通常是根据教师模型的预测构建出来的，然后对所有训练样本一视同仁地套用，这就导致在类别和领域发生变化时，这个目标变得不可靠。在这篇论文里，我们认为蒸馏目标的构建应该被当作一个动态的训练决策，而不是一套固定配方。为此，我们提出了 OnPoKD，一个用于视觉语言模型适配的在策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation）框架。据我们所知，OnPoKD 是首个将策略蒸馏应用于视觉语言模型适配的框架，它把目标构建本身当作一个策略决策来学习。OnPoKD 学习了一个轻量级的控制器，利用来自教师模型、学生模型和零样本先验（zero-shot prior）的可靠性信号和分歧信号，为每个样本构建自适应的目标。这个控制器不再依赖固定的教师预测，而是通过有界的策略动作，动态地平衡教师监督、零样本先验引导和硬标签锚定，让蒸馏目标能够根据样本可靠性和训练阶段的不同而变化。策略控制器通过验证反馈来更新，鼓励目标构建去优化可迁移性，而不仅仅是拟合训练分布。由于控制器只在训练时使用，OnPoKD 可以无缝集成到现有的视觉语言蒸馏流程中，同时保留原来的推理架构和测试时的开销。在基础到新类泛化（Base-to-novel generalization）和跨数据集迁移（Cross-dataset transfer）基准上的大量实验表明，OnPoKD 能持续超越那些强大的视觉语言蒸馏基线。

articles.title: TRACE: Training Reasoning Agents for Causal Exploration with Synthesized Rewards
articles.zh: TRACE：用合成奖励训练因果探索的推理Agent
articles.summary: 如果你训Agent卡在奖励信号难设计，这篇用合成奖励让Agent自己去探索因果链
articles.author: Rui Sun, Zhan Shi 等

articles.title: One Loop, Two Gains: Can Active Learning win the Lottery for Free?
articles.zh: 一次循环，两份收益：主动学习能免费赢下彩票吗？
articles.summary: 如果你在纠结主动学习和彩票假设该选哪个，这篇说两者能在同一个循环里同时吃到
articles.author: Benedikt Tscheschner, Eduardo Veas 等
articles.body: The lottery ticket hypothesis posits the existence of winning tickets: sparse subnetworks that, when trained in isolation from their original initialization, match the accuracy of the full dense network. The predominant method for discovering such tickets, iterative magnitude pruning, alternates pruning with full retraining from scratch until convergence over many cycles. Similarly, deep active learning also retrains a model from scratch after each acquisition round as new labels become available. Despite this shared reliance on iterative retraining with a substantial computational overhead, the two paradigms have been studied separately. We observe that the iterative training loop inherent to pool-based active learning already provides the exact computational structure that iterative magnitude pruning exploits, and propose Improve & Prune (I&P), a method that integrates magnitude pruning into each active learning retraining cycle at practically no additional cost. This raises a key empirical question: can iterative magnitude pruning produce winning tickets under the non-stationary data regime of active learning? We investigate this question across multiple acquisition functions, architecture families, and image classification datasets, including an active fine-tuning scenario. Our results demonstrate that I&P yields sparse, deployable models at each active learning iteration. Those match the accuracy of their dense counterparts at sparsities up to 95%, effectively obtaining winning tickets as a byproduct of the active learning pipeline. These per-iteration sparse models can address two computational bottlenecks - per-round model retraining and acquisition scoring over the unlabeled pool - that currently prevent the practical adoption of DAL on large architectures and large unlabeled pools.
articles.bodyZh: 彩票假说（lottery ticket hypothesis）认为，网络里可能存在“中奖彩票”（winning tickets）：也就是一些稀疏子网络（sparse subnetworks），只要拿它们原来的初始化（original initialization）单独训练，准确率就能追上完整的稠密网络（dense network）。现在找这类中奖彩票最主流的方法，叫迭代幅度剪枝（iterative magnitude pruning）：它一遍遍地剪枝，再从头完整重训，直到很多轮之后收敛。类似地，深度主动学习（deep active learning, DAL）也是在每一轮采集（acquisition round）拿到新标签后，把模型从头再训一遍。虽然这两种思路都靠反复重训，而且计算开销都不小，但大家一直把它们分开研究。我们发现，基于池的主动学习（pool-based active learning）本身自带的迭代训练循环，其实正好提供了迭代幅度剪枝所需要的那套计算结构。于是我们提出了“改进并剪枝”（Improve & Prune, I&P）：把幅度剪枝直接塞进主动学习的每一次重训循环里，几乎不增加额外成本。这就带出一个很关键的实证问题：在主动学习这种数据分布不断变化的非平稳环境（non-stationary data regime）里，迭代幅度剪枝还能不能造出中奖彩票？我们围绕多个采集函数（acquisition functions）、多种网络架构家族（architecture families）和多个图像分类数据集做了研究，还包括一个主动微调场景（active fine-tuning scenario）。结果发现，I&P 在主动学习的每一轮迭代里，都能给出稀疏、可直接部署的模型。它们的稀疏度最高到 95% 时，准确率还能和对应的稠密模型打平，等于说我们把中奖彩票当成主动学习流程的副产品顺手拿到了。这些每一轮迭代得到的稀疏模型，能解决两个计算瓶颈——每轮重新训练模型，以及在未标注样本池上做采集打分（acquisition scoring）——而这两个瓶颈，正是目前挡住 DAL 在大架构和大规模未标注样本池上实际落地的关键。
